name: Applicants review page and applicant CSV export with named columns and formula-safe formatting
request: Applicants review page and applicant CSV export with named columns and formula-safe formatting
checks: npm run check passed (typecheck, build, 348 tests, validate)
result: Added the Job Applicants review page and the applicant CSV export. csv.js now exports its primitives - neutralizeFormula, serializeValue, escapeCell, buildCsvFile and downloadCsvText - so src/applicant-csv.js inherits the UTF-8 BOM, CRLF endings, quoted cells, formula neutralization and the leading-apostrophe text guard on mobile rather than copying any of them. APPLICANT_CSV_COLUMNS leads with APPLICANT_TABLE_COLUMNS column for column (job title, name, email, mobile, location, current role, current company, total experience, must-have met, preferred met, resume, application status, collected at) and a test holds the exported list and the rendered table header in step; the structured detail follows, one value per line, with qualifications printed as verdict, requirement, explanation and source. applicants.html, applicants.css and src/react/applicants-dashboard.tsx are a new React 16 class-component page with search, job/status/resume filters, 25/50 pagination, per-row selection, a details drawer holding the full verdicts and the extraction warnings, Download CSV and Download Selected. build.mjs and validate-build.mjs cover the new page and its four React entry points, and the Saved Profiles page links to it.
